description: Ground-truth expectations for racemap. Covers the reported algif_skcipher race, four zero-copy attack-surface patterns (A-D), and three known CVEs (CVE-2022-0847 Dirty Pipe, CVE-2022-2590, CVE-2026-43284 Dirty Frag). Each pattern/CVE fixture holds a vulnerable and a fixed variant via #ifdef FIXED; the scanner must flag the vulnerable variant as likely_race and exonerate the fixed variant.

impact: unsnapshotted shared state passed to async request
data-confidentiality impact on the async request path
algif.report: Reported to security@kernel.org (2026-06-07) by this project's author, Muhammet Kaan KILINÇ, who also authored the fix; accepted by the stable maintainers (2026-07-17), queued for 7.1.y, 6.18.y, 6.12.y, 6.6.y, 6.1.y, 5.15.y, 5.10.y. Assigned CVE-2026-74578 (CVSS 3.1: 7.1 HIGH). Fix: https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/stable/linux.git/commit/?id=b05defc41b27c7d0c05c45f67bf5b91c28f93669

cases.rationale: io_uring registered buffer fed to crypto without copy/unpin.
pipe page consumed without pipe_buf_get/.get callback.
get_user_pages result fed to AEAD without COW/put_page.
skb mutated after skb_zerocopy without skb_unshare.
PIPE_BUF_FLAG_CAN_MERGE without flag init / page-ownership check (Dirty Pipe).
copy_from_user under mmap_read_lock with no VMA stability re-check.

In-place AEAD decrypt (src == dst) over an skb with possibly-shared fragments and no skb_has_shared_frag() guard — the ESP in-place-decryption bug, CVE-2026-43284 (Dirty Frag), expressed against the equivalent TIPC path. The fixed variant adds the shared-fragment guard.
